name: TRIGLYCERIDE
description: Triglyceride measures circulating triglyceride levels and evaluates cardiovascular risk and metabolic disorders. This test assesses dyslipidemia and guides lipid-lowering therapy.

testdetails.instrumentation: Beckman Coulter, Roche Cobas, Abbott Architect

literatureReview: Triglyceride measures neutral fat in circulation. Normal <150 mg/dL. Borderline high 150-199 mg/dL, high 200-499 mg/dL, very high ≥500 mg/dL. Elevated levels increase cardiovascular risk, especially with low HDL. Causes include obesity, diabetes, alcohol, hypothyroidism, and genetic disorders. Enzymatic colorimetric assay using lipase, glycerol kinase, and peroxidase. Fasting sample required (10-12 hours). Used in lipid profile assessment and cardiovascular risk stratification. Treatment includes lifestyle modification, fibrates, and omega-3 fatty acids. Triglyceride:HDL ratio is a strong CVD predictor.
